name: @engine/storefront
description: Old East Indies' storefront (PLAN-V2 §4.2, TASKS.md 23.3): the shop's pages, views, blocks, shell, lexicon and the loaders and actions behind them — home, browse, collections, product, bag, checkout, payment, tracking, stores, partnership, the CMS pages and search. Both apps draw it until phase 26: today's app under `app/(shop)/shop/[locale]/…`, the shop app under `app/[locale]/…`, each with thin route files. Payload is reached through `@engine/cms/instance` — today's app resolves it to the one CMS, the shop app aliases it to cms-shop's instance — and the shop's records are found with `@engine/cms-shop/site`'s `shopOnly`, so no `site` filter is written here.
